posts.title: August & September 2026 Recap: The Flywheel Accelerates
posts.subtitle: Over the past two months, DFDV returned to active SOL accumulation, grew its treasury by roughly 10% in six weeks, and launched CHAD, a new Digital Credit instrument designed to add another engine for long-term SPS growth.

posts.title: Introducing CHAD: Digital Credit Comes to Solana
posts.subtitle: Bitcoin proved the digital credit model; we believe Solana can take it further.

posts.title: June & July 2026 Recap: Sharpening the Focus
posts.subtitle: June and July were defined by discipline, sharper positioning, and record-setting Solana fundamentals. While prices remained under pressure, DFDV streamlined the organization, formalized the SOL Boost framework, expanded validator adoption, and stayed focused on one objective: compounding SOL Per Share through the cycle.

posts.title: The SOL Boost Framework: How DFDV Delivers Leveraged Solana Exposure
posts.subtitle: Most ways to gain leveraged SOL exposure come with liquidation risk or volatility decay. Discover how DFDV combines structured leverage, capital markets, and SPS growth to amplify Solana exposure through the public markets.

posts.title: Solana Reborn: 3 Network Changes That Could Catapult SOL To New Highs
posts.subtitle: Solana's next chapter may not be defined by faster transactions or greater adoption, but by stronger tokenomics. Three proposed network upgrades could reduce issuance, increase staking participation, and dramatically expand SOL burns, creating a tighter link between network growth and value accrual for holders.

posts.title: April & May 2026 Recap: Focused on What Matters Most
posts.subtitle: Markets may slow down, but execution doesn't. Over the past two months, we remained focused on growing SOL Per Share, expanding the Digital Asset Treasury ecosystem, and strengthening DFDV's position as the premier vehicle for leveraged SOL exposure.

posts.title: Digital Credit & Private Credit: The Case for a New Yield Category
posts.subtitle: What if private credit's biggest advantage was never the yield, but the lack of transparency? As digital credit brings double-digit income, daily liquidity, and real-time visibility to investors of all sizes, the traditional private credit model is facing its first serious challenger.

posts.title: The SOL Bull Case: Three Demand Vectors Reshaping Solana
posts.subtitle: A bottom-up look at the three demand vectors driving crypto demand for the next decade, and why Solana is positioned to capture a disproportionate share.

posts.title: Mar. 2026 Recap: Strengthening the Foundation
posts.subtitle: With market activity slowing, we continued advancing research, partnerships, and capital strategies designed to support long-term SOL per share growth.

posts.title: Every Agent Needs a SOL: Sizing the Opportunity for Agentic Finance on Solana
posts.subtitle: As AI agents begin to trade, pay, and transact autonomously, they will need a financial system built for machines. We believe Solana is emerging as the settlement layer for that future.

posts.title: Feb. 2026 Recap: Building Through Volatility
posts.subtitle: In a volatile February for digital assets, DFDV continued executing its SOL-first strategy, publishing original valuation research, expanding strategic investments, and reinforcing long-term SPS growth.

posts.title: SOL & the Digital City: A New Way to Value Layer 1 Tokens
posts.subtitle: A new framework for valuing SOL based on structural demand and constrained free float, reframing it as scarce digital real estate within a rapidly expanding onchain economy. Under our base case assumptions, the model implies a long-term price of approximately $10,000 per SOL.
